info.title: Asana
info.description: Manage Asana tasks, projects, sections, subtasks, tags, and status updates. Extends the certified connector with task updates, search, kanban automation, and project health reporting.

put.description: Updates an existing Asana task. Can change the name, assignee, due date, notes, completion status, and other fields.

parameters.name: task_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the task to update.

assignee.description: GID of the user to assign, or null to unassign.

due_on.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null to clear.

due_at.description: Due date and time in ISO 8601 format. Setting this also sets due_on.

completed.description: Set to true to mark complete, false to reopen.

notes.description: Free-form plain-text description of the task.

html_notes.description: Rich text description in HTML format.

liked.description: Whether the authenticated user likes this task.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the task.

due_at.description: Due date and time in ISO 8601 format.

permalink_url.description: URL to the task in the Asana web app.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a task. This action cannot be undone.

parameters.name: task_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the task to delete.

get.description: Returns a list of tasks in a specific Asana project. Use opt_fields to control which task fields are returned.

parameters.name: project_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response next_page.offset value.

parameters.name: completed_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Only returns tasks completed after this time or incomplete tasks. Use now for only incomplete tasks.

parameters.name: opt_fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Override to customize returned data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of tasks.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the task.

due_on.description: Due date of the task in YYYY-MM-DD format.

modified_at.description: Last modified datetime in ISO 8601 format.

permalink_url.description: URL to the task in the Asana web app.

completed_at.description: Datetime the task was completed in ISO 8601 format.

num_subtasks.description: Number of subtasks on the task.

get.description: Searches for tasks in a workspace using advanced filters. Requires a paid Asana plan. Rate-limited to 60 requests per minute.

parameters.name: workspace_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the workspace to search in.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Full-text search on task name and description.

parameters.name: assignee.any
parameters.description: Comma-separated user GIDs to filter by assignee.

parameters.name: projects.any
parameters.description: Comma-separated project GIDs to filter by project.

parameters.name: sections.any
parameters.description: Comma-separated section GIDs to filter by section.

parameters.name: tags.any
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag GIDs to filter by tag.

parameters.name: completed
parameters.description: Filter by completion status. True for completed, false for incomplete.

parameters.name: is_subtask
parameters.description: Filter for subtasks only when set to true.

parameters.name: modified_at.after
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Return tasks modified after this time.

parameters.name: modified_at.before
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Return tasks modified before this time.

parameters.name: due_on.after
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return tasks due after this date.

parameters.name: due_on.before
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return tasks due before this date.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort field: due_date, created_at, completed_at, likes, or modified_at. Default is modified_at.

parameters.name: sort_ascending
parameters.description: Sort direction. Default is false (descending).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: opt_fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the task.

due_on.description: Due date of the task in YYYY-MM-DD format.

modified_at.description: Last modified datetime in ISO 8601 format.

permalink_url.description: URL to the task in the Asana web app.

get.description: Returns all sections (columns in Board view, groups in List view) in a project.

parameters.name: project_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default is 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of sections.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the section.

post.description: Adds an existing task to a specific section in a project, effectively moving it to that workflow stage.

parameters.name: section_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the target section.

task.description: The globally unique identifier of the task to add to the section.

insert_before.description: GID of a task in the section to insert before for ordering.

insert_after.description: GID of a task in the section to insert after for ordering.

200.description: Successfully added the task to the section.

post.description: Creates a new subtask under an existing parent task.

parameters.name: task_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the parent task.

assignee.description: GID of the user to assign to the subtask.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the new subtask.

get.description: Returns all subtasks of a given parent task.

parameters.name: task_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the parent task.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: opt_fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of subtasks.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the subtask.

get.description: Returns projects in a workspace, optionally filtered by team or archived status.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the workspace.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: GID of a team to filter projects by.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Filter by archived status. Default is false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: opt_fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of projects.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the project.

current_status_update.description: Latest status update on the project.

status_type.description: Status type (on_track, at_risk, off_track, on_hold, complete).

post.description: Adds an existing tag to a task. Tags are workspace-level labels that can be applied across projects.

parameters.name: task_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the task.

tag.description: The globally unique identifier of the tag to add.

200.description: Successfully added the tag to the task.

get.description: Returns all tags in a workspace.

parameters.name: workspace_gid
parameters.description: The globally unique identifier of the workspace.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default is 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of tags.

post.description: Creates a status update on a project, portfolio, or goal. Status updates communicate project health to stakeholders.

parent.description: GID of the project, portfolio, or goal to post the status on.

text.description: Plain-text body of the status update.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the status update.

status_type.description: Status type (on_track, at_risk, off_track, on_hold, complete).

text.description: Plain-text body of the status update.

created_at.description: Datetime the status update was created.

parent.description: The parent object the status was posted on.

get.description: Returns status updates for a project, portfolio, or goal, ordered by creation date (newest first).

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: GID of the project, portfolio, or goal.

parameters.name: created_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Only return updates created after this time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: opt_fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of status updates.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the status update.
